  model_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

  msrp_new INTEGER,
  fake_risk TEXT
);
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE listings_fts USING fts5(
  avito_id UNINDEXED,
  title,
  description,
  params,
  tokenize = 'unicode61'
)
/* listings_fts(avito_id,title,description,params) */;
CREATE TRIGGER listings_ai AFTER INSERT ON listings BEGIN
  INSERT INTO listings_fts(avito_id, title, description, params)
  VALUES (new.avito_id, COALESCE(new.title, ''), COALESCE(new.description, ''), COALESCE(new.params, ''));
END;
CREATE TRIGGER listings_ad AFTER DELETE ON listings BEGIN
  DELETE FROM listings_fts WHERE avito_id = old.avito_id;
END;
CREATE TRIGGER listings_au AFTER UPDATE ON listings BEGIN
  DELETE FROM listings_fts WHERE avito_id = old.avito_id;
  INSERT INTO listings_fts(avito_id, title, description, params)
  VALUES (new.avito_id, COALESCE(new.title, ''), COALESCE(new.description, ''), COALESCE(new.params, ''));
END;
